decisions.reason: The glass flake system extends the firm's core spraying expertise into heavy-duty corrosion protection, so the engineering already sunk into it and its fit with the firm's announced direction favour persisting, and slow uptake can still be blamed on market ramp-up.
Its dedicated web page is a visible public commitment within the established construction repair offer, and management will want to justify that commitment by keeping the pump.
A multi-model product line carries substantial sunk development and tooling investment and is central to material conveying, so management will persist and treat any disappointment as temporary.
Launched only in 2024 and close to the core two-component spraying business, it has had too little time to prove itself, so early weak results would be attributed to ramp-up.
